run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-17T05:06:27Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: frontend-proxy's request-error signal is real in this window: its error-status span count jumps from 0 to 372 in a single minute and its ingress 5-minute error ratio goes from 0 to ~0.028-0.029, then falls back to ~0.0006 (facts). The proxy's own access log shows the failures as HTTP 500 on GET/POST /api/cart and POST /api/checkout, all proxied to upstream 'frontend' (100.96.3.80:8080), between 05:09:07 and 05:09:29, with 200s resuming at 05:10:20. In the same window the frontend service's own error spans are exclusively cart/checkout paths (grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, CartService/AddItem, CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, executing api route /api/cart and /api/checkout, plus tcp.connect failures). The cart Deployment was rolled at 05:08:57-05:09:00 (new ReplicaSet cart-84889c965d, same 2.1.3-cart image, old ReplicaSet cart-755465879b scaled to 0). The cart container declares no readinessProbe, so the replacement pod was reported Ready at 05:09:00 while its logs show it only began listening at 05:09:25 and served its first request at 05:09:33 - a gap in cart serving that matches the frontend 500s. Two limits keep this partial: the alert's own rule is not loaded in this Prometheus (its expression, evaluation window and the annotated 0.0111 value are unverified), and the alert's startsAt (05:06:27) precedes the rollout by ~2.5 minutes, which only matches stray error spans (2 in the minute ending 05:05:30), not the burst. A separate fraud-detection pod OOMKill/restart at 05:14:27 is observed but not tied to this alert.

claims.text: frontend-proxy error-status spans moved from a zero baseline to a burst: sum(increase(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="frontend-proxy",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[1m])) is 0 at every 30s point from 05:01:00 to 05:10:00, 372 at 05:10:30, then 0/6/2 afterwards.

The frontend-proxy 'ingress' error ratio (sum(rate(errors[5m]))/sum(rate(all ingress spans[5m]))) is 0 at 05:01:27-05:04:27, 0.0003-0.0006 at 05:07:27-05:09:27, 0.0283/0.0285/0.0294/0.0290/0.0292 for windows ending 05:10:27-05:14:27, and 0.0015 at 05:15:27.

The same 5m ingress error ratio was already elevated earlier in the window (0.0419 at 04:48:27, decaying through 0.0215, 0.0145, 0.0115, 0.0092 to 0 at 05:01:27), i.e. an earlier decaying error episode preceded the alert.

frontend-proxy access logs show HTTP 500 responses on GET /api/cart, POST /api/cart and POST /api/checkout, each logged with upstream 'frontend 100.96.3.80:8080' and 'via_upstream', at timestamps 05:09:07.010 through 05:09:29.934; a normal 'POST /api/cart 200' appears at 05:10:20.500.

In the 15-minute window ending 05:21:00 the frontend service's own error spans by operation were: GET 23.9, GET /api/cart 23.9, POST 72.7, POST /api/cart 54.0, POST /api/checkout 18.7, executing api route (pages) /api/cart 77.9, executing api route (pages) /api/checkout 18.7, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart 23.9, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem 54.0, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 18.7, tcp.connect 7.3; all of these were 0 by 05:23:00.

Deployment cart in namespace otel-demo was rolled during the window: a new ReplicaSet cart-84889c965d (image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-cart, readyReplicas 1, created 05:08:57) replaced cart-755465879b, which now has spec.replicas 0 and no ready replicas with the same image; the pod list shows the new cart pod cart-84889c965d-tkxdz with startTime 05:08:57 while all other otel-demo pods started 04:37:47-04:39:42, and the event grouping for namespace otel-demo records one Pod 'Killing', three Pod 'Created', one ReplicaSet 'SuccessfulCreate', one ReplicaSet 'SuccessfulDelete' and two Deployment 'ScalingReplicaSet'.

The cart container of Deployment cart declares readinessProbe: null (strategy RollingUpdate maxSurge 25% / maxUnavailable 25%); the replacement pod cart-84889c965d-tkxdz reached condition Ready=True with lastTransitionTime 05:09:00, while its own log shows 'Now listening on' at 05:09:25.310 and its first request 'GetCartAsync' at 05:09:33.614 - i.e. it was marked Ready roughly 25s before it could serve.

Of the 21 Deployments in namespace otel-demo, only otel-collector declares a readinessProbe; cart (revision 2), frontend, frontend-proxy, checkout and the rest declare none, so 'Ready' for them is set as soon as the container starts.

The alerting entity itself is up and unchanged: pod frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-v4lvt is Running and ready with restartCount 0 and startTime 04:37:49, its ReplicaSet frontend-proxy-6b4d584985 is deployment revision 1 with readyReplicas 1, and its 500 log lines identify upstream 'frontend' as the origin rather than a proxy fault.

A separate pod failure occurred in the window: pod fraud-detection-9fb7d885b-v48vh shows restartCount 1 with lastState terminated reason OOMKilled, exitCode 137, finishedAt 05:14:27, and the otel-demo event grouping records three Pod 'Started' events; its logs at 05:13:50-05:14:25 show normal order consumption with no error lines.

Across services, only frontend and frontend-proxy show a burst in the 10-minute error-span increase series in this window; accounting, checkout, payment, cart and currency returned 0 at every returned point, while ad, fraud-detection and recommendation held a flat ~1.05 errors per 10m before and around the burst.

Jaeger trace coverage in this Run ends before the failure: a frontend-proxy trace search over 04:40:00-05:27:40 returned spans starting only at 04:54:52.562610 to 04:54:53.262283, all with http.status_code 200 and no error rows.

The alert's startsAt (05:06:27) precedes the cart rollout (new ReplicaSet created 05:08:57) and the 500 burst (05:09:07-05:09:29) by about 2.5 minutes, and the annotated value 0.0111 does not equal any measured frontend-proxy ingress error ratio in this window (0 at 05:04:27, 0.0003 at 05:07:27, ~0.029 during 05:10:27-05:14:27), so the burst does not by itself explain when the alert first activated.

Because the alert condition is 'error rate above 0', its initial activation at 05:06:27 is most plausibly a stray-error trigger rather than the later burst: the 1-minute error-span increase shows 2 error spans in the minute ending 05:05:30 and 0 before that, and the 5m ratio is only 0.0003 at 05:07:27.

The frontend-proxy 5xx burst is explained by the cart rollout under a missing readiness gate: the replacement cart pod was Ready at 05:09:00 but not listening until 05:09:25, the previous cart ReplicaSet was scaled to 0 at the same time, and the frontend error spans in the burst are exclusively CartService/GetCart, CartService/AddItem, CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, /api/cart, /api/checkout and tcp.connect - the call paths a cart endpoint gap would break.

The fraud-detection OOMKill/restart at 05:14:27 did not cause this frontend-proxy error alert: the 5xx burst ended at ~05:09:30, five minutes before the OOMKill, and fraud-detection's error-span level was a flat ~1.05 per 10m through the burst rather than a spike.

Add a readinessProbe to the cart container (and to the other otel-demo workloads that lack one) so the endpoint is not marked Ready before it listens, and avoid rolling the only replica out with maxUnavailable 25%: e.g. readinessProbe on the CART_PORT 8080 listener with maxUnavailable 0 for single-replica Deployments.

Locate and review the RequestErrorRate rule definition outside this Prometheus and consider a small non-zero threshold or a minimum-request-rate guard, since a '>0' condition is tripped by single stray error spans as well as by real bursts.
Check the memory limit of the fraud-detection container, which was OOMKilled (exit 137) at 05:14:27 and restarted once; this is a separate reliability issue from the frontend-proxy alert.

gaps: No alerting rule is loaded in this Prometheus: the RequestErrorRate rule lookup (1db5236f-bc22-4ec7-b48e-aacf66bf3409-t0:595b90f1-8b3f-488c-bd72-b6b8d5b79a0a) and the type=alert rule listing (d515e53f-4b83-412a-a59e-c67a51f481ec-t0:32e2f6b9-3e98-4a68-bc36-8bb0d110e3ac) both returned no_data, so the alert's expression, evaluation window and the annotated value 0.01111111111111111 could not be verified.

change_history is not an integrated source in this Run, so who applied the cart Deployment pod-template change and what exactly changed could not be determined; the old pod is gone, so its spec cannot be compared.

Jaeger has no trace covering 05:08-05:12 (newest returned span starts 04:54:52.562610), so no span-level error detail such as a gRPC status code or connection-refused message for the burst could be read.

fetch_pod_logs for pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-64mj8 returned no_data for 05:06:00-05:20:00 (3249e2f4-d982-4637-8a24-955ff5466764-t0:cca6f19e-3a73-4f2b-9607-7b1ff7de6a15 and 8fbf1a16-e4a9-40d7-aa6e-e248d04358dc-t0:ec601383-4ccd-4458-bce0-b2ce0541683b), so the frontend-side error text behind its 500 responses is unverified.

The origin of the stray frontend-proxy error spans around 05:05 is unknown: the 4xx/5xx access-log query for 05:03:00-05:07:00 returned no_data (541654bd-128c-413b-94e3-30bd5e7a32e3-t0:2d8b406a-5448-4db6-aa18-342f4efe5333), and traces do not cover that time.

Trace-span metric times appear offset from container-log times by roughly one minute (metric burst at 05:10:30 versus logged 5xx at 05:09:07-05:09:30), so the exact start instant of the degraded interval is known only to about a minute.
Log views returned here were incomplete by design (newest N lines of a larger match set and/or a 4 MiB read limit), so lines outside the returned slices remain unknown.
next_steps: Retrieve the RequestErrorRate alert rule (expression, 'for' duration, threshold) from the Alertmanager/Prometheus rule source to confirm which window and value produced the 0.0111 reading.
Query deployment/change history (GitOps/CI or audit log) for Deployment cart in namespace otel-demo around 05:08:57Z to identify the actor and the exact pod-template delta.
Confirm from the frontend container's own logs (with a retained log store) that its 500s on /api/cart and /api/checkout were gRPC failures to cart during 05:09:00-05:09:30.
Review the memory limit and runtime settings of the fraud-detection workload after its OOMKilled restart at 05:14:27Z.
